preconditions.expression: isinstance(input, str) and input.islower() and input.replace(' ', '') == input
preconditions.description: The input is a non-empty lowercase string with no spaces.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == 2 and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output is a list of exactly two strings.
Both output strings have the same length as the input string.
The first output string has uppercase letters at even indexes (0, 2, ...) and lowercase elsewhere.
The second output string has uppercase letters at odd indexes (1, 3, ...) and lowercase elsewhere.
